comment: Single source of truth for the FliHub capability catalog. Consumed by the SvelteKit app (src/lib/capabilities/catalog.ts) and by the PocketBase hooks (pb_hooks/flihub_capabilities.pb.js) via a shared JSON require — do not fork this list.

templates.label: League

templates.description: Start from nothing and choose capabilities deliberately.
